llm.summary: This is a coherent Notion-based memory skill, but it persistently stores sensitive personal state and includes broad Notion/local write helpers that users should review before installing.

dimensions.detail: Access to Notion credentials is expected, but the bridge exposes generic Notion API calls and local write paths are caller-controlled, which is broader than a tightly scoped memory/journal workflow.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill declares Node and NOTION_API_KEY requirements, depends on notion-api-automation, and has no package dependencies or install-time execution in the inspected package files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions encourage proactive profile updates, daily or heartbeat-style state capture, and quiet ambient recall; these are purpose-aligned but under-scoped for sensitive personal data retention and first-use consent.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill is explicitly built for durable local and remote persistence, including emotional state, journals, memories, staged recall, and USER.md profile facts, without strong retention, deletion, or confirmation controls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, durable memory, mood/state tracking, journaling, and identity continuity, matches the Notion database setup and memory scripts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intentionally want an agent to preserve long-term memories, emotional/state summaries, journals, and selected profile facts in Notion and local workspace files. Use a Notion integration limited to the intended pages/databases, review stored data periodically, avoid feeding secrets or intimate personal details into memory writes, and prefer local-only operation when remote persistence is unnecessary.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Notion credentials and script execution are expected and declared in metadata, but users should still understand that the skill can perform durable remote writes.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Database and page creation are needed for setup, but the shared bridge also includes broader patch/query/archive-style helpers that exceed a narrowly scoped memory writer.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The generic httpJson helper can call arbitrary Notion API paths and methods, making the installed skill broader than the documented journal and memory commands.
[SQP-2] expected: The README does disclose Notion externalization of memory, emotion/state, and journal data, but it lacks clear retention, deletion, and sensitive-data consent guidance.
[SQP-2] expected: USER.md promotion is constrained by rules against secrets, financial data, intimate data, and ephemeral facts, but it still creates persistent profiling by default when the agent judges a fact durable.
[SQP-2] expected: Local mirrors and Notion-backed state are central to the skill and are disclosed, with a local-only fallback mentioned, but remote persistence remains the normal path.
[SQP-2] unexpected: conflict_track.js can write or append to arbitrary caller-supplied paths, rather than being limited to a dedicated skill-owned memory location.
[SQP-2] expected: ltm_write.js sending memory entries to Notion is expected, but it accepts freeform stdin content without an inline confirmation or redaction step.
